info.name: Cisco Webex Create an Attachment Action

items.docs: Creates an attachment action representing a user's interaction with an adaptive card. The action captures the user's input from the card form fields.

info.name: Cisco Webex Get Attachment Action Details

params.name: id
params.description: Unique identifier for the attachment action.

items.docs: Shows details for an attachment action by ID. Returns the action metadata and user-provided input data from the adaptive card.
